proposal.summary: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 have incorrect filesystem ACLs on the local installation folder, granting excessive privileges to local users that may allow system destruction or execution of malicious programs.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm affected versions and reproduction steps; collect exact ACL settings and which accounts receive excessive privileges; determine whether local admin privileges are required; obtain exploitability evidence and provide vendor/patch timeline.
